Class ControllerExperienceAdd

java.lang.Object
guiExperienceAdd.ControllerExperienceAdd
public final class ControllerExperienceAdd extends Object
Loads the authorized parent lesson and submits the experience draft through the model (KG04). The view retains rejected input; success returns to lesson details only after storage succeeds.
